description: This file defines classes that implement raw input devices such as keyboard, mouse, and touchscreen for browser automation, including methods to simulate key presses, mouse movements, clicks, and wheel actions within a BiDi (Bidirectional) protocol context.

classes.name: RawKeyboardImpl
classes.description: Implements raw keyboard input methods, such as key down, key up, and send text, using BiDi protocol actions.

classes.name: RawMouseImpl
classes.description: Implements raw mouse input methods including move, down, up, and wheel, utilizing BiDi protocol actions.

classes.name: RawTouchscreenImpl
classes.description: Stub implementation for touchscreen input, currently only includes a tap method.

methods.name: setSession
methods.description: Sets or updates the internal BidiSession for input device actions.

methods.name: keydown
methods.description: Simulates a key down event using the BiDi input protocol.

methods.name: keyup
methods.description: Simulates a key up event using the BiDi input protocol.

methods.name: sendText
methods.description: Simulates typing a string of text via key down/up events.

methods.name: _performActions
methods.description: Internal helper to perform a sequence of input actions via the session.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Moves the mouse cursor to specified coordinates.

methods.name: down
methods.description: Simulates pressing a mouse button at specified coordinates.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Simulates releasing a mouse button at specified coordinates.

methods.name: wheel
methods.description: Simulates a mouse wheel scroll at specified coordinates.

methods.name: tap
methods.description: Simulates a tap on touchscreen; currently a stub with no implementation.
